mentions.name: Multiplayer Card Game (Python)
mentions.description: A multiplayer card game written in Python, using Kivy for the desktop and mobile game UI and aiohttp for the server. The core game engine is implemented by hand, while an AI agent builds the remaining parts incrementally under supervision against detailed technical and game-design specification documents. The plan is to reach beta by the end of the year and publish the game on Steam by mid-2027.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm writing a multiplayer card game based on an idea I had during COVID. It's been in the back of my mind ever since.

It's being written entirely in Python: Kivy for the desktop and mobile game UI, and aiohttp for the server.
